verdict.rationale: Box AI is a built-in assistant that lets users ask questions, extract metadata, summarize, and generate content directly within Box, with enterprise permissions intact, and configurable AI models via Box AI API — this is a first-party, in-product assistant rather than a third-party bolt-on. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating real-world quality and reliability of the built-in assistant beyond vendor docs.
